# Behavioural results

Generated by `make behave`. Each cell compares the trace of a converted pipeline on its target engine with the trace of the source pipeline on its own engine.

Totals: 622 pass, 55 diff (explained by the loss report), 0 FAIL (unexplained), 19 blocked.

- `pass`: same ordered markers and same exit code.
- `diff`: every difference has a loss report entry of the right job or step and of a kind that can cause it (the rule is printed in the diff list).
- `FAIL`: a difference that no loss report entry explains. The converter is wrong.
- `blocked`: the engine cannot judge the pair (see the blocked list). Blocked cells are unverified, not clean.

## Blocked pairs

- 6 cells: Argo needs an artifact repository for artifacts, and the harness cluster has none (https://argo-workflows.readthedocs.io/en/latest/configure-artifact-repository/)
  - gha->argo artifacts/push-branch, gha->argo artifacts/push-main, gitlab->argo artifacts/push-branch, gitlab->argo artifacts/push-main, tekton->argo workspace-chain/push-main, tekton->argo workspace/push-main
- 5 cells: Concourse has no pull request event: the converted file has no pull request resource, so no resource version stands for it (https://github.com/concourse/git-resource/blob/v1.9.1/README.md, check: the versions are commits of one branch or tags; pull requests need the separate reso...
  - drone->concourse branch/pr, drone->concourse excludepushtag/pr, gha->concourse branch/pr, gitlab->concourse mrjob/pr, woodpecker->concourse branch/pr
- 2 cells: act 0.2.90 does not count a failed job with continue-on-error as a success for the jobs that need it (nektos/act v0.2.90 pkg/runner/job_executor.go setJobResult reads the job error only, not continue-on-error)
  - gitlab->gha allow_failure/push-branch, gitlab->gha allow_failure/push-main
- 6 cells: blocked: the source failed on its own engine (exit 1): Command failed with exit code 1: git config user.email / Command failed with exit code 1: git config user.name / Command failed with exit code 128: git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
  - gitlab->argo images/push-branch, gitlab->concourse images/push-branch, gitlab->drone images/push-branch, gitlab->gha images/push-branch, gitlab->tekton images/push-branch, gitlab->woodpecker images/push-branch

## Engine capabilities

- drone: no commit SHA: drone exec ignores DRONE_COMMIT_SHA from its flags, its env file and the process environment, so the env.sha marker is not compared on a pair with drone
- argo: artifacts unsupported (Argo needs an artifact repository for artifacts, and the harness cluster has none (https://argo-workflows.readthedocs.io/en/latest/configure-artifact-repository/))
- concourse: events push-main, push-branch, tag (Concourse has no pull request event: the converted file has no pull request resource, so no resource version stands for it (https://github.com/concourse/git-resource/blob/v1.9.1/README.md, check: the versions are commits of one branch or tags; pull requests need the separate resource type https://github.com/telia-oss/github-pr-resource))
- gha: a workflow with a job that has continue-on-error and a dependent job is blocked (act 0.2.90 does not count a failed job with continue-on-error as a success for the jobs that need it (nektos/act v0.2.90 pkg/runner/job_executor.go setJobResult reads the job error only, not continue-on-error))
